text:
maria: quick check — post-canary telemetry for model:nova-v2 looks mostly green but p95 token latency spiked to ~420ms during the 10:15x burst. obs dashboard: https://go/obs/nova-v2-canary
kevin: saw that too. error-rate steady, but latency spike coincides with a small subset of long-context requests. might be KV cache eviction pattern.
deploybot: [deploybot] Canary enable completed at 1765004200. Traffic 5% -> 20% over 30m ramp. No automatic rollback triggered.
maria: proposal: proceed with staggered enable but add fallback ordering that prefers legacy-nova-1 for requests > 2048 tokens and for EU region until we validate tail. Pin list: nova-v2=20% global; fallback priority: legacy-nova-1, quant-nova-v2-8bit.
sre_liz: +1 on region gating. Suggest SLA guard: if p95 > 350ms for 1h we auto-deprioritize nova-v2 to 0% and alert oncall. Also set error-rate threshold 0.5% 
kevin: timeline? change window 18:00-20:00 UTC to broaden traffic if we pass another 3h of telemetry. Need release notes blurb for customers about improved quality vs latency regression note.
tara: I'll draft release note: one paragraph, call out fallback ordering and pinning for long-context EU traffic. Link when ready.
ops_raj: can we add a short-lived pin for a handful of internal routes (search-preview, chat-eval) so we can soak without affecting public traffic?
maria: yes — add route pins: /internal/* -> nova-v2 100% for 2h with explicit tag so rollback is easier. Ops, please add to deploybot payload.
kevin: deploybot payload snippet (for ops):
```
models: ["nova-v2"]
traffic: 20
pins: [{"route":"/internal/*","percent":100,"ttl":"2h"}]
fallback_order: ["legacy-nova-1","quant-nova-v2-8bit"]
rollback_triggers: {"p95_ms":350,"error_pct":0.5}
change_window: "18:00-20:00 UTC"
```
ops_raj: adding now. will include the canary telemetry patch in the deploy metadata.
deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled enable for 1765007800 (18:10 UTC). Canary pins and route overrides included. Watchlist channels: #eng-releases, #eng-runtime, #incidents.
sre_liz: Oncall FYI: if we hit p95 breaches, run rollback plan A (deprioritize model and drain KV caches) then plan B (force-legacy pin). I'll paste runbook shortly.
maria: thanks — tagging @kevin for final signoff before we hit the window. If nobody objects by 17:40 UTC we proceed with schedule. :thumbsup:
kevin: signoff from me. proceeding.
ops_raj: done — deploybot scheduled payload uploaded and release note draft here: https://go/docs/release/nova-v2-draft
maria: great. post-mortem/notes: keep fallback ordering configurable via catalog so we can iterate without redeploying. I'll open a follow-up ticket after cutoff.
kevin: noted. last call to update pins or rollback thresholds by 17:40.
tara: releasing note to staging docs now.
kevin: thanks all.
